actions.title: Walk without spilling
actions.situation: A brim-full cup carried through a turn, a stop and a restart. The hand follows a smoothed guide path rather than the bobbing chest, so the arm absorbs the walk. The spill check measures the cup's horizontal jerk every frame.

actions.title: Sprint and reconsider
actions.situation: A sprint, a glance at someone, braking steps that get shorter, a turn, and a casual walk back with the hands in the pockets. The brake comes before the reversal: the strides shorten over three steps.

actions.title: Crouch under trouble
actions.situation: A low beam across the path. The walk drops into a crouched walk before the beam, the head looks back once without the feet breaking stride, and she stands only after her head has cleared it. The beam is solid: head, chest and hands are checked against it.

actions.title: Spin and find the target
actions.situation: A full turn on the spot in two half turns while Shim walks round her. When the spin ends her eyes find him first, then the head, then the feet step round to face him. The feet and the hips turn together; nothing teleports.

actions.title: Jump into water
actions.situation: To the end of the pier, a hesitation (lean out, rock back), the jump, the entry, then up to the surface and a turn to face the pier. Under the water line the floor check is suspended and buoyancy counts as support.

actions.title: Catch the ledge
actions.situation: A run, a jump that only just makes it, both hands on the top edge, the body hanging below the grip, then the pull-up: chest above the edge, straight arms lifting the hips over it, a foot onto the top, standing. The block is solid, so no part of her may pass into it.

actions.title: Slip and recover
actions.situation: A step onto a slick patch. The front foot runs forward, the arms windmill, the back foot steps under the body to catch it, and she stays up. The slide and the moment off balance are declared; the recovery step must land where the weight went.

actions.title: Stand after a fall

actions.title: Punch that misses
